Title: Get pet with invalid ID (negative)
Steps:
1. Send GET /pet/invalidId (non-numeric string)
2. Verify error response
Expected Result: Status 400 or 404. Error message returned (actual: inconsistent — sometimes returns NumberFormatException).

Title: Get deleted pet (negative)
Steps:
1. Delete a pet
2. Immediately send GET /pet/{petId}

Title: Add pet without required field (negative)
Steps:
1. Send POST /pet with body missing 'name' field
2. Verify error response
Expected Result: Expected: Status 400 with validation error. Actual: API returns 200 (BUG — see BUG-003).

Title: Find order with out-of-range ID (negative)
Expected Result: Status 404. Order not found (spec says IDs must be 1–10).

Title: Get deleted user (negative)
Steps:
1. Delete a user
2. Immediately send GET /user/{username}
